model_output.rationale: 835 shows CO-27 on all lines with MOA N30. 271 confirms EB*6 (inactive) with DTP*357=20250930 — coverage terminated before DOS 2025-10-11. Payer is commercial (CI). No EB*R or successor payer. CO-27 on a commercial plan where the patient was not a member on DOS means the hold-harmless clause does not apply. No overrides (QMB, Medicaid, ACA grace period) present. Patient is billable.

root_cause.explanation: Patient's Delaware Valley Mutual EPO coverage ended 2025-09-30 (DTP*357). DOS 2025-10-11 is 11 days after termination. Commercial payer correctly denied under CARC 27.

next_action.detail: Bill patient for $181.71. Coverage was inactive on DOS; no hold-harmless protection applies to a non-member. Verify no other active coverage before sending statement.

evidence.fact: EB*6 (inactive) with DTP*357*D8*20250930 confirms coverage ended before DOS 2025-10-11
All four lines denied CO-27 with MOA N30; CLP status 4 (denied); filing indicator CI (commercial)
No EB*R segment — no other payer on file for this member/DOS

citations.rule: CI, EB*6 + 357 before DOS, no successor: CO-27 → bill_patient once overrides clear — hold-harmless reaches members only
